article.title: “Dialectical Materialism and Quantum Physics: The Unpublished 1957 Lectures of David Bohm in Israel”: Hanoch Gutfreund and Jürgen Renn (eds)- Review
article.author: Editor
article.content: Many Marxists over the years have argued that dialectical philosophy is not applicable to the natural sciences, often seeing Friedrich Engels as the chief culprit in this misapplication, although there have been notable opponents such as Sean Sayers and John Bellamy Foster. The post “Dialectical Materialism and Quantum Physics: The Unpublished 1957 Lectures of David Bohm in Israel”: Hanoch Gutfreund and Jürgen Renn (eds)- Review appeared first on MR Online .
